The system replaced their legal name on the booking with "Testy Mr Tester". However, the lab order has the correct legal name. Many patient's have still been able to proceed with their lab appointment despite this hiccup.If anyone reaches out and states the lab is unable to locate their name/booking or their booking is under "Testy Mr Tester" please send the following macro. Please review.UPDATES-Sublingual Progesterone 300mg We will no longer be offering progesterone sublingual 300 mg for new patients or for follow-ups and the patients will be receiving a blast message letting them know about the change. We are going to broaden the pilot program to several other patients in different states. Please ALWAYS first check to see if a lab order was generated. If no lab order was generated, that means they are part of our no labs pilot program. Please do not offer labs to these patients. -Charge cost of labs if outside of a subscription In the following two scenarios we will manually charge the patient a $35 fee for lab work. updates.body: Camryn Burden Hi @channel there was an erroneous message automatically sent out by CIO to HRT patient's who completed there eval stating: "Hi there, welcome to Fountain – glad to have you here! The next step is scheduling your lab appointment. What times/dates would be good for you to go into a nearby lab for a blood test?"This was sent in error. Labs were not included at check out for these patient's as previously discussed. Rob has fixed this system error. Please send the following macro to these patient's with their VV scheduling link. Thanks!Title: System Error causing lab scheduling message to send to HRT sign ups after 1/21/26"Hi there, we apologize for the confusion—our system sent the previous message regarding lab scheduling in error.At this time, the next step is to schedule your initial video visit with one of our providers. If you haven’t already done so, please use the link below to book your appointment:[Insert scheduling link]We look forward to speaking with you soon!"
